summary: Implementation and tests fully match the saved plan: git_auth.py gains bitbucket_askpass_script, bitbucket_agent_git_config_entries, and apply_bitbucket_agent_git_auth (with the worker credential-helper path byte-for-byte unchanged and a new regression test locking it); secret_mounts.py materializes the static 0o555 askpass script, mounts it read-only, and wires GIT_ASKPASS/GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT/insteadOf only when the BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN lease is injected. Tests cover all planned cases (a)-(f) including the rendered-compose leak-proof boundary, offline insteadOf rewrite for HTTPS + both SSH forms, no-loop, token-only/email-only/non-bitbucket gating, GIT_CONFIG_COUNT accumulation, and read-only+executable static script. The only remaining gap is the absence of AWF-owned validation evidence for this workspace.
